sections.text_helper: Section 28.8.16 "SAES key register 7 (SAES_KEYR7)" in chapter 28 (Secure AES coprocessor (SAES)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 887.

Address offset: 0x03C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 KEY[255:224]: Cryptographic key, bits [255:224]

relative to writing SAES_KEYRx registers.
